        self.add_plot("Stop Level", self._calculate_stop())

        # Return early if ATR is not ready or no bar exists for SPY
        if not self.atr.is_ready or not data.contains(self.spy.symbol):
            return

        close_price = bar.close
        
        # Check re-entry condition

            # Re-enter the market
            self.set_holdings(self.spy.symbol, 1.0)
            # Update trailing high to current close
            self._trailing_high = close_price
            # Clear the waiting flag
            self._waiting_to_reenter = False
            return

        # Check if portfolio is currently invested
        if not self.portfolio.invested:
            # Initial entry
            self.set_holdings(self.spy.symbol, 1.0)
            # Set initial trailing high
            self._trailing_high = close_price
            return

        # Update trailing high
        self._trailing_high = max(self._trailing_high, close_price)
        
        # Calculate stop level
        stop_level = self._trailing_high - (3.0 * self.atr.current.value)
        
        # Check for stop loss trigger

            self.liquidate(self.spy.symbol)
            # Set flag to wait for re-entry
            self._waiting_to_reenter = True
            # Reset trailing high
            self._trailing_high = 0.0
            
            # Update plots for the next bar
            self.add_plot("Trailing High", self._trailing_high)
            self.add_plot("Stop Level", stop_level)

    def _calculate_stop(self):
        """Helper method to calculate current stop level for plotting."""
        if self._trailing_high == 0.0:
